blocks.text: Overview

Telegram trading bots are on fire. With more than 800 million users, Telegram has become a go-to platform for on-chain users, giving them a convenient way to interact with DeFi through a familiar chat experience.
Why users love Telegram bots
Always connected: Telegram is already where users spend time, making it ideal for trading updates and interactions.
No hassle: users can trade and receive alerts without leaving the app.
Mobile ready: designed for trading on the go.
Social by default: users can share tips, trades, and results inside their existing communities.
Familiar chat interface: conversational interaction makes trading feel intuitive and less intimidating.
The Vertex opportunity

Launch a fully branded Vertex Telegram trading bot on Perpie's battle-tested infrastructure, which has processed more than $25M in trading volume. Vertex can reach Telegram-native traders without taking on the development and maintenance overhead of building the stack internally.
Instant mobile presence: reach Telegram's 800M+ monthly active users.
First-mover advantage: establish Vertex inside Telegram before direct competitors.
Keep users engaged with a convenient, chat-native way to use Vertex.
Differentiate Vertex with value-adding features designed for an intuitive conversational experience.
Why Partner With Perpie
Battle-tested security: enterprise-grade infrastructure with more than $25M in processed volume and real self-custody.
Zero technical overhead: development and maintenance are handled by Perpie.
Complete customization: Vertex's brand and rules on Perpie's infrastructure.
A broad feature set is available out of the box.
Chat convenience with self-custody security

Perpie combines a responsive chatbot experience with a lightweight transaction interface. When a signature is required, a secure interface opens for a quick confirmation instead of placing private keys on project-owned servers.
Perpie-specific embedded wallet: a customizable wallet with secure self-custody and a seamless user experience.
Frictionless authentication: social MPC or biometric authentication while users maintain custody.
Account abstraction to improve security and UX.
Client-side transactions: Perpie servers never come into contact with private keys.
Feature Suite
Trading Experience
AI-powered natural-language interaction for retrieving data and executing actions through commands such as “ape into ETH,” “what's my best trade so far?” or “exit all my positions.”
Smart order types including stop-loss and take-profit, manageable through chat commands.
Interactive real-time charts and analysis directly inside Telegram.
One-click execution for frequent trades.
Complete P&L history and performance analytics.
Gas abstraction so users can pay fees in tokens they already hold.
Personalized notifications for positions, market movement, and account activity.
Community & Engagement
Perpie Groups: add the Vertex bot to Telegram groups and turn them into social trading hubs.
Real-time group notifications when members trade or take other actions.
Live P&L leaderboards and dynamic performance rankings.
Live trader tracking and alerts for top performers.
Automated trading competitions with anti-gaming measures.
Built-in referrals that turn successful traders into Vertex ambassadors.
Direct User Communication
Broadcast targeted announcements, product updates, and market news to user segments.
Run interactive surveys directly inside the conversation.
Create exclusive communities for VIP traders, beta testers, or specific strategies.
Analyze trading patterns, feature usage, and engagement.
Protocol Controls
Flexible fee management and real-time adjustments.
Configurable trading limits and risk controls.
Optional gas sponsorship for selected users or actions.
Feature enablement by user segment.
Promotion creation and performance tracking.
Track Record
$400K received across two grants from GMX and Arbitrum.
$0 to $25M in trading volume with minimal marketing.
Demonstrated rapid product and integration delivery.
Why Now

Crypto trading is shifting toward Telegram. Hundreds of thousands of users trade on-chain through Telegram bots each month, and protocols are beginning to move into the channel. Vertex can capture market share early and establish itself as a mobile-first innovator.
Our Proposal
Vertex Integration Notes
Vertex provides multiple SDKs, which should simplify the trading and listener client integrations.
Vertex does not support ERC-1271 smart-contract-account signatures, so an EOA must sign on behalf of the SCA.
Append a LinkSigner operation for the SCA's EOA signer during deployment.
The execution system must support Vertex API transactions in addition to standard on-chain transactions.
Clients must be able to forward Vertex API-specific transactions.
Vertex subaccounts require additional implementation work.
The bot must show margin and non-margin balances.
Deposit and withdrawal flows are required between the wallet and margin account.
The bot interface requires additional work to represent cross-margin correctly.
Integration Milestones
Milestone 1 — full Vertex trading integration into the whitelabel bot: 50% of total payment upfront and 25% at completion.
Create and manage positions and orders.
Cross-margin support, including margin/non-margin balances and wallet-to-margin deposits and withdrawals.
Real-time notifications and charting.
Wallet secured by biometrics and social login; currently Web3Auth MPC, subject to future change.
Trader tracking, price alerts, P&L cards, and social groups with leaderboards.
AI-powered commands in alpha.
Milestone 2 — multi-subaccount management, cross-chain deposits, and on-ramp: final 25% at completion.
Create and manage multiple Vertex subaccounts.
Deposit-flow mini-app for easy onboarding to the Vertex Telegram bot.
Cross-chain deposits from any chain into the wallet.
Direct deposits from popular centralized exchanges.
Card on-ramp into the Vertex trading account.
Fees
One-time integration fee paid by milestone: $100K in stablecoins or VRTX.
50/50 split of trading fees generated through the bot.
Distribution
Distribution is controlled by Vertex; the bot is completely whitelabeled to the Vertex brand.
Built-in growth tools include referrals, trading competitions, segmented broadcasts, gas sponsorship, and incentives for KOLs to add the Vertex bot to their Telegram groups.
Next Steps
Review the proposal and identify any features that should be changed, omitted, or added.
Review the system diagram and agree on the best implementation for a trading-fee bump.
Agree on an appropriate fee basis-point level for trades made through the bot.
